@graph.description: Before heading off on your vacation, be sure you understand your travel insurance plan coverages or get coverage for your trip with Travel Guard.

@graph.name: Baggage Coverage and Baggage Delay
@graph.description: Baggage Coverage is included on all Travel Guard travel insurance base plans and can provide reimbursement for recovering or replacing covered personal items if luggage is lost, stolen or damaged during a trip. Baggage Delay is a separate coverage that may reimburse the cost of purchasing necessary personal items when luggage is delayed or misdirected for a significant period of time.

priceSpecification.description: Baggage Coverage is included on all Travel Guard base plans; certain plans offer higher benefit limits as part of a baggage upgrade.

acceptedAnswer.text: Baggage Coverage is included on all Travel Guard travel insurance base plans, although on certain plans you can purchase higher benefit limits as part of a baggage upgrade. In the event your luggage is lost, stolen or damaged during your trip, Baggage Coverage can provide reimbursement for recovering or replacing covered personal items.

mainEntity.name: How do I use Baggage Coverage?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your luggage is lost, stolen or damaged you can submit a claim to request reimbursement. Be sure to obtain the required documentation for your claim when necessary – like an incident or police report if your luggage is stolen.

mainEntity.name: Are there limits to the reimbursements I can claim for baggage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, there are limitations with regard to reimbursements for Baggage Coverage. These limitations vary by travel insurance plan and item. Jewelry, watches, furs and electronic devices have an aggregate coverage amount on most plans, and all items have a per-item limit. Details of Baggage Coverage and limits can be found in your Policy of Insurance.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a receipt for lost or damaged items in my baggage?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it is possible to file a claim on your baggage without a receipt, covered items costing over $150 without a receipt will not be reimbursed for more than $150.

Baggage Delay is a coverage on your Travel Guard travel insurance plan that may reimburse you for the cost of purchasing certain necessary personal items when your luggage is delayed or misdirected for a significant period of time (the length of the delay varies by plan).

mainEntity.name: What kind of items are considered necessary personal effects?

acceptedAnswer.text: Necessary personal effects are items such as clothing and toiletries that were in your luggage and necessary for your trip.

mainEntity.name: How do I use Baggage Delay coverage?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you’re traveling and your luggage is delayed or misdirected, save the receipts of the necessary items you purchase. You can file a claim to request to be reimbursed for those essential items.

mainEntity.name: Is Baggage Delay covered under the Baggage Coverage benefit?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Baggage Delay is a separate coverage within your Travel Guard travel insurance plan, which may provide reimbursements for necessary personal items while your baggage gets to your intended destination.

mainEntity.name: Can I file a Baggage Delay claim for items I left behind at a hotel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Baggage Delay benefit can only be claimed if the delay is caused by a common carrier. Other exclusions can be found in your travel insurance plan, which should be reviewed before heading off on your vacation.

mainEntity.name: What documentation do I need to file a claim for Baggage Coverage or Baggage Delay?

acceptedAnswer.text:
The specific documentation needed for your baggage claim will depend on the reason for delay/loss and the items you are claiming for. Below is a list of documentation that may be required.

- Travel Guard claim form
- Repair invoices for damaged baggage that you had repaired
- Incident reports
- Receipts for any claimed expenses
- Copy of homeowner’s or renter’s insurance

There may be additional documents required based on your specific claim. You can start the process of filing a claim online with our claims portal or you can call us directly if you have specific questions.
